en.title: Anson Mount's Star Trek Villainy: A Look Back Before Pike
en.summary: Before commanding the Enterprise on Star Trek: Strange New Worlds, Anson Mount took on a very different role in the world of superheroes. Fans might be surprised to learn about his past brush with a young Lex Luthor.
en.body:
Long before **Anson Mount** became the steady, reassuring presence of Captain Christopher Pike on **Star Trek: Strange New Worlds**, he navigated the treacherous landscape of Metropolis in **Smallville**. While his current star turn as the Enterprise captain is celebrated for its gravitas and thoughtful leadership, Mount's earlier foray into the DC Comics universe saw him on the opposite side of a nascent hero.

In the 2003 **Smallville** episode "Precipice," Mount portrayed Paul Hayden, a character whose actions put him at odds with a young, ambitious Lex Luthor, played by **Michael Rosenbaum**. This wasn't a heroic turn; Hayden was involved in a scheme that threatened innocent lives, making him a villain in the context of the show's ongoing narrative about Luthor's descent. It's a fascinating piece of casting trivia that sees the actor who would later embody a Starfleet captain playing a decidedly un-Starfleet role, offering a glimpse into the diverse career path that led him to helm the Enterprise.

## A Villain's Shadow on the Path to Heroism

The irony isn't lost on fans who have followed Mount's career. His portrayal of Paul Hayden in "Precipice" positioned him as an antagonist to Lex Luthor, a character whose own journey from ambitious businessman to Superman's arch-nemesis is central to **Smallville**'s enduring appeal. While Luthor himself was often portrayed with complex motivations, even a villainous role in his orbit showcased Mount's ability to inhabit characters with morally ambiguous or outright negative intentions. This stands in stark contrast to his universally praised performance as Captain Pike, a beacon of integrity and optimism, proving his range extends far beyond the bridge of the Enterprise.

## Fan Connections and Mount's Sci-Fi Legacy

For **Star Trek** aficionados and **Smallville** fans alike, this casting detail adds another layer of appreciation for Mount's contributions to genre television. His journey to becoming Captain Pike was itself a testament to fan demand; after impressing audiences in **Star Trek: Discovery** season two, a significant fan campaign led to the greenlighting of **Star Trek: Strange New Worlds**. Mount's ability to connect with audiences, whether as a morally compromised individual on **Smallville** or a beloved captain in the final frontier, underscores his talent. It’s a reminder that many of today’s most iconic heroes and villains have humble, sometimes unexpected, beginnings.

## What's Next

**Anson Mount** continues to captivate audiences as Captain Pike in **Star Trek: Strange New Worlds**, with new episodes eagerly anticipated. Fans can also look forward to any future announcements regarding further seasons or related projects within the expansive Star Trek universe.

content_raw: The Captain Pike actor has participated in numerous sci-fi and fantasy TV projects over the years, including this ironic role in the teen Superman saga.
